subject: Kia Sonet

specs.name: turbo_power
specs.source_sentence: The Kia Sonet's 1.0-litre T-GDi turbo-petrol produces 120 PS of power and 172 Nm of torque.

specs.name: turbo_torque
specs.source_sentence: The 1.0 turbo-petrol makes 172 Nm, paired with a 6-speed iMT or a 7-speed DCT.

specs.name: engine
specs.source_sentence: The Kia Sonet is offered with a 998 cc 1.0-litre T-GDi turbo-petrol, a 1.2-litre petrol and a 1.5-litre CRDi diesel.

specs.name: transmission
specs.source_sentence: The 1.0-litre turbo-petrol comes mated to either a 6-speed iMT or a 7-speed DCT automatic.

specs.name: mileage
specs.source_sentence: The mileage of the Kia Sonet HTK (O) Turbo iMT is 18.4 kmpl.

specs.name: boot_space
specs.source_sentence: The Kia Sonet offers a boot space of 385 litres.

specs.name: length
specs.source_sentence: The Kia Sonet is a sub-four-metre SUV at 3,995 mm long.

specs.name: body_type
specs.source_sentence: The Kia Sonet is a sub-4-metre subcompact SUV.

specs.name: features
specs.value: electric sunroof, ventilated front seats, ADAS Level 1 (10 features), 360-degree camera, Bose 7-speaker, 10.25" digital cluster
specs.source_sentence: The Kia Sonet is offered with an electric sunroof, front ventilated seats, ADAS Level 1 with 10 autonomous features, a 360-degree camera, a BOSE premium 7-speaker system and a full digital cluster with a 26.04 cm (10.25 inch) colour LCD.

specs.name: dimensions
specs.value: 3,995 mm L / 1,790 mm W / 2,500 mm wheelbase
specs.source_sentence: The Kia Sonet measures 3,995 mm long and 1,790 mm wide, with a 2,500 mm wheelbase.

_source_note: India-market facts from CarDekho (2026 Sonet). Wikipedia's Mexico-spec 113 hp / 144 Nm was rejected. Owner CarDekho-verifies power/price at Gate 1.
